actual_request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE newly drawn genuine game WALK sprite N14-v1 for09_bamboo_archer_girl, phase14 of16 distinct phases for a480ms grounded cycle.
Input1 is the exact identity, direction and costume of the original bamboo archer, already established from the original portrait. Input2 is the approved project painting style. Precisely redraw ONLY legs, boots and small natural hem/arm responses of Input1 for the requested gait phase. Preserve the exact head, ponytail, hair ornaments, face, torso, outfit construction, equipment, camera and painted style. Keep the bow in the SAME hand and screen position as Input1, and the quiver on the SAME shoulder. Do not remake the outfit or face. 
DIRECTION: NORTH, full BACK view walking directly away toward top of frame. View only back of head, ponytail, shoulders and rear of tunic. NO face, eyes, chest decoration or front yin-yang buckle visible on the back. Her anatomical left is screen LEFT; the bow is carried on screen LEFT, quiver at screen RIGHT shoulder.
POSE PHASE: RIGHT support foot stays grounded under torso. LEFT thigh has moved ahead of RIGHT, LEFT knee flexed and boot hangs forward with toe down, heel elevated. Body rises only slightly. In N screen LEFT boot swings away/upward, screen RIGHT supports; in SW near LEFT leg (hip on screen RIGHT) now advances down-left across depth, with the far RIGHT foot still grounded.
Explicit BACK anatomy: anatomical LEFT is image LEFT. LEFT knee swings away, left boot toe points away with almost no sole visible; RIGHT heel stays low supporting. Keep camera, costume, bow handedness, head and torso size fixed as PRIMARY reference. This is anatomical pose redrawing only, no mirror, no copied pose translation.
One complete newly drawn full-body pose on ONE square native canvas at least1024x1024, preferably1536x1536, highest available visual quality. Original soft upper-left lighting. Fixed orthographic game sprite camera pitched down10 degrees. Head to grounded sole about84 percent of canvas height, vertical body axis centered horizontally, grounded sole baseline92 percent height. Keep full bow tips, hair, ribbons and both boots inside generous margin, no cropping. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, clear empty spaces also inside enclosed gaps between string/bow/hair/legs. No colored matte, painted checkerboard, floor shadow, backdrop, gradient, glow, text, number, frame border or watermark. One newly drawn genuine anatomical walking phase, no collage, no sheet, no repeated pose or mirrored anatomy; no hop, running, flying or attacking.
